title: Nexplorer
tagline: Mint your first NFT stress-free—no wallet, no jargon. Learn Web3 by doing, step-by-step!
description: Nexplorer is a storybook‑themed, beginner‑friendly web app that onboards Web2 users into Web3 by guiding them to mint their first NFT—without jargon or complexity. The experience is intentionally warm and narrative-driven, using approachable typography and clear language to demystify wallets, minting, and ownership. Users learn by doing: they name an NFT, optionally add an image, preview it, and complete a simulated mint with a confirmation step and instant feedback
how_its_made: Nexplorer is built with a modern Web3-first stack: the frontend uses React, TypeScript, and Vite with TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, and GSAP for smooth, animated experiences, while Wagmi and RainbowKit provide seamless wallet connectivity on Polygon. The backend runs on Node.js with Express, Supabase for Postgres-based data storage, and Socket.IO to deliver real-time updates for campaigns and leaderboards. On the blockchain layer, MoonForge leverages both Polygon PoS for fast, low-cost user interactions and Polygon zkEVM for enterprise-grade scalability and security, supported by custom smart contracts for the ERC-20 MoonForge token, campaign escrows, and vesting modules, all developed with Hardhat and Foundry. The Graph powers campaign indexing and analytics, and IPFS/Pinata ensures decentralized storage for assets, together forming a transparent, scalable, and efficient Web3 growth engine.
